B.describe: Apparently strong controls: every core confirmation reported in place, while the supporting practices behind them are reported weak, so the answers are inconsistent.

status.stopLabel: The interview asked everything it needed to

stages.currentLabel: Every applicable confirmation has been reached: answered, with a function or listed as outstanding

consistency.limitation: Each cross-check is one further self-reported answer from the organisation about a practice that supports a confirmation it reported in place. It is not a test of operation and it is not evidence. Confirmations that were not selected were not cross-checked, and nothing is concluded about them or extrapolated to them. No score or band is adjusted for any outcome.

stages.note: Counts are "so far": a later answer can bring further questions into scope or take them out.
